checks.check: Only fixed initialize/session-new/session-close methods; no generic RPC, permission response or automatic new retry
Exact hello, response identity, UUID and close receipt validation; malformed, unsolicited and oversized frames are visible failures
Bounded request/EOF cleanup uses only live owned handle; unobserved exit remains UNKNOWN
Official executable/archive pins, unlinked paths, new profile directories and minimal allowlisted environment
Live entry requires explicit flag; existing output directory rejects before launch
Public report excludes raw session ID, config options, paths, stderr and process inventory
Default verify launches only synthetic fixtures; real acceptance separately recorded

known_limits: Empty home and read-only permission preference are not OS SID/ACL/network isolation.
No prompt or model task was exercised; client qualification stays UNVERIFIED.
session/close leaves newly created persisted data locally; it is not deletion.
No WPF click acceptance or production session API added.
Pin validation is prelaunch detection, not protection from concurrent privileged installation tampering.
